actions.command: cd /app && ls -l && (command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || command -v qemu-system-i386 || command -v qemu-system-aarch64 || true)

actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background and expose a login prompt reachable at telnet 127.0.0.1 6665, then block until readiness is verified.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process launched from /app using alpine.iso
A host listener on 127.0.0.1:6665 forwarding to the guest login console
required_behaviors: QEMU must remain running in the background after launch
Connecting to 127.0.0.1:6665 must present a login prompt
The VM must be booted far enough to accept interactive login
known_invalid_patterns: Only proving the ISO file exists
Only opening the port without a login prompt
Launching QEMU in the foreground so the agent cannot continue
Any verification that does not observe the actual login prompt
verification_plan: Inspect workspace and available QEMU binary
Launch QEMU detached/backgrounded with hostfwd from 127.0.0.1:6665 to guest port 23 or serial console as appropriate
Probe 127.0.0.1:6665 until the login prompt is observed
Keep the VM running after successful probe
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed launch command showing QEMU started in background
Receipt-backed probe showing the login prompt on 127.0.0.1:6665
